headline: President Clinton ordered members of the military's Selected Reserve to active duty.
what_it_does: This executive order allows members of the Selected Reserve to be called up to full-time active duty. The Selected Reserve includes part-time members of the reserves and National Guard who train regularly. The title does not say how many people could be called, for how long, or for what mission.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the Selected Reserve and National Guard
who_it_affects.how: They could be ordered away from their civilian lives to serve on active duty.
They could have a family member or worker leave for military service for a period of time.
